title: Details & Updates
body:
Details & Updates

Dates & Events

Over the week of October 27 to October 30, two events happened together:

The OpenStack Conference (Tuesday - Thursday)
This is a great place for attendees of all levels to learn about OpenStack through keynotes, speaking sessions, hands-on labs, and our ecosystem marketplace.
The OpenStack Design Summit (Tuesday - Friday)
These are dedicated working sessions where OpenStack developers and operators plan the roadmap for the next software release.
Summit Timeline

The Full Access Pass gives you the ability to attend the keynotes, marketplace, business sessions and working groups, encompassing everything the Summit has to offer in Tokyo.

The original Summit pass timeline image is no longer available.

Code of Conduct
Please review the OpenStack Code of Conduct, which applies to all events and community forums, including the OpenStack Summit.
Summit News & Updates

Lunch Menus and Locations Now Available

Check video monitors for real time updates about lunch availability.

Meals and lunch boxes can be found across the Summit Campus. Kosher and Halal meals will be available in Hokushin, Bldg. #3, 3F. Please ask a server for more information. Gluten Free and Vegetarian options will be available in Marmolada, Bldg. #1, B1F and Il Leone, Bldg. #1, B3F. 

You can find all lunch menus and a map of lunch locations by going here.

#vBrownBag Tech Talk Schedule Now Available

#vBrownBag Tech Talk Schedule is now available. The Tech Talks are brief 10-minute sessions presented to a very small audience at the Summit. The talks are video recorded and posted online within 24 hours.

Most of the Wednesday slots are filled by the Women of OpenStack.
